target.statement: PC2-based pointwise judge (ours) with Deepseek-R1 as judge achieves 0.6962 accuracy, versus naive pointwise judging at 0.5694.
target.dataset: SCAN-HPD human-preference evaluation set (636 examples across writing, roleplay, knowledge, coding, mathematics, reasoning)

compute.basis: The judge itself must be a large model such as Deepseek-R1; using APIs avoids local GPUs but still requires many paid/closed-model calls over the preference set, and the exact data/prompt release is unclear.

blockers: Requires closed-source or very large judge models (Deepseek-R1, Qwen3-32B, claude-3.7-sonnet, gpt-4.1) that a 16 GB CPU laptop cannot run locally
Availability of the human-preference labels and model responses for the judge-accuracy table is not clear
PC2 evaluation prompts/configs may not be fully released or may require substantial reconstruction
title: SCAN: Structured Capability Assessment and Navigation for LLMs
